title: SFL Manifest
description: Tracks which Set it Free Loop components are deployed to a consumer repository and at what version.

version.description: The SFL version that was deployed (e.g., '2.0.0').

deployedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the deployment was performed.

tier.description: The deployment tier selected during installation.

source.description: The source repository in org/repo format.

sourceSha.description: The git SHA of the source repo at deployment time. Use 'self' when the SFL repo dogfoods its own loop.
